Method of Attack: Steals personal data from web browsers, mail clients, and FTP servers; collects screenshots and videos; captures clipboard data.
Attack Vector: Malicious Microsoft Office documents with embedded VBA scripts that leverage legitimate websites (MediaFire and Blogger) to execute a shell script and deliver payloads.
Indicators of Compromise: Persistence mechanisms: Scheduled tasks using mshta, creation of lnk and exe files in the 'Startup' and 'Templates' folders.
